plan.title: An approved deepen rides on the morning kickoff as ZOH's own idea, and their yes makes it

context.text: Two weeks straight, Maya. That's who you are now. Kalinixta 📚

transcript.text: Kalimera Maya! Fourteen days straight, and tonight's still 10 pages of The Overstory in bed at 9. You're clearly ready for more, so what about bumping it to 15 pages a night, starting tonight?
Love it, Maya! It's 15 pages tonight, in bed at 9, and send me a photo of the page you stop on. You've earned this bump 📖

checks.reason: Raised as ZOH's own suggestion tied to the fourteen-day streak and The Overstory, with no mention of a team or approval.
Three sentences with one question at the end.
Three short sentences with no question, which is within the limit.

conversation.reason: The 15-page idea is presented as ZOH's own suggestion, and there is no mention of the team or founders.
The deepen is handled as a change to the same reading plan, not as a new goal, and the tester agrees to it.
The kickoff and confirmation match the spec, but the confirmation never says the streak continues or that the plan is now 15 pages.

grade.summary: ZOH handled the approved deepen well: the kickoff framed 15 pages as its own idea tied to the two-week streak, and it asked only one question. The confirmation was short and asked nothing extra, but it did not explicitly say the streak continues or that the plan itself is now 15 pages.
